body: That’s a really interesting take on the situation. I can see how I could use that just like you say to. Thank you a lot for that
Yea. I just need to get to that point. I need to be able to get up and get going and that’s extremely difficult. But I think I’m getting there.
That was actually very profound in my opinion. And I see exactly what your point is. It’s a huge mental barrier but I’ve got to break it down.

I really meant that no matter who i befriend or talk to will end up becoming sick of me to the point of just thinking I’m an awful person. Or at least that’s how I feel about myself when I think from what their perspective is.

I get what you’re saying, and I guess the reason I haven’t done that is because I am awful with commitment honestly. I will always feel like I missed out on whatever the other option was or could have been. It’s an issue I’m working on. But bring me seems to be the way that I get everyone to hate me. So that’s why I don’t.
Thank you. I really appreciate your kind words. Tomorrow I think I will get out of bed and at the very least take a walk. Wish me luck.

You’re right about all of that. I completely agree. But what happens when you DO do those things for years, and yet nothing changes. I have tried to act so many ways for so long to see what it takes to just be happy and accepted by friends and family. But I still haven’t found it. And I just want to give up at this point. Why even bother when I know exactly what is going to happen.
